privacy: Aggregate diagnostic codes only. No chat messages, user identities, IP addresses, API keys, or raw exception messages.
limits: Syntax and targeted smoke tests cannot detect every logic bug or verify every factual answer. Runtime counts require authenticated read-only access. Automatic source repair is limited to verified local cache entries and versions; other bugs require review.
